title: Theme editor: centered header and the floating Simple bar
detail: Two pieces of plan steps 3 and 4 that LIVE-1997 left out on purpose. (1) The `centered` header option is in dials.json but held out of the options (NOT_YET_STORABLE in lib/theme/dials.ts) because adding it to SITE_LOOK_OPTIONS.header would show it in every theme's existing Style rows before any renderer draws it; add it together with the first theme whose header does. (2) Mount ThemeControls variant="bar" as the compact bar floated over the live preview, beside the Theme tab panel, calling the same handlers.
